title: ULPF Prism — Unified Overview
description: Cross-vendor perimeter-event health, security decisions and normalization quality.

list.name: vendor
list.label: Vendor
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT vendor FROM ulpf.events_v1 ORDER BY vendor

list.name: product
list.label: Product
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT product FROM ulpf.events_v1 WHERE match(vendor, '${vendor:regex}') ORDER BY product

list.name: category
list.label: Category
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT category FROM ulpf.events_v1 ORDER BY category

list.name: action
list.label: Action
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT action FROM ulpf.events_v1 ORDER BY action

list.name: severity
list.label: Severity
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT severity_label FROM ulpf.events_v1 ORDER BY severity_label

list.name: quality
list.label: Quality
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT quality_status FROM ulpf.events_v1 ORDER BY quality_status

targets.rawSql: SELECT uniqExact(event_id) AS value FROM ulpf.events_v1 FINAL WHERE $__timeFilter(observed_at) AND match(vendor, '${vendor:regex}') AND match(product, '${product:regex}') AND match(category, '${category:regex}') AND match(action, '${action:regex}') AND match(severity_label, '${severity:regex}') AND match(quality_status, '${quality:regex}')
SELECT count() AS value FROM ulpf.quarantine_v1 WHERE $__timeFilter(quarantined_at)
SELECT countIf(has(error_codes, 'STORAGE_WRITE_FAILED')) AS value FROM ulpf.quarantine_v1 WHERE $__timeFilter(quarantined_at)

SELECT toStartOfMinute(observed_at) AS time, count() AS events FROM ulpf.events_v1 FINAL WHERE $__timeFilter(observed_at) AND match(vendor, '${vendor:regex}') AND match(product, '${product:regex}') AND match(category, '${category:regex}') GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

SELECT action, count() AS events FROM ulpf.events_v1 FINAL WHERE $__timeFilter(observed_at) AND action IN ('allow','deny','block') AND match(vendor, '${vendor:regex}') GROUP BY action ORDER BY events DESC
SELECT severity_label, count() AS events FROM ulpf.events_v1 FINAL WHERE $__timeFilter(observed_at) AND match(severity_label, '${severity:regex}') GROUP BY severity_label ORDER BY events DESC
